reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, skipsWeekendOccurrences and getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers rather than re-deriving the weekend rules.

duplication.why: The skip-or-shift composition (skip weekend days for daily, otherwise shift when skipWeekend) is written again in the same shape as in getUpcomingDates instead of being factored into one per-occurrence helper.

placement.why: New handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered alongside it.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, typed and commented (WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS); the repeated skip/shift composition is a small future divergence risk.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the shared weekend helpers from #shared/schedules.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange restates getUpcomingDates' skip/shift chain (filter skipsWeekendDays && isWeekend, then skipWeekend && !skipsWeekendDays ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend : date) as a loop with precomputed shiftsWeekend flag.
